## Goal
Plan and validate the complete next action before persistence, then commit promotion through the existing FlowStore revision CAS exactly once.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R6 definition/rule/schema/instruction/target/task/maxAttempts failure matrix accepts integer `1..10_000` inclusive and sends non-integers、values below 1、and values above 10_000 through the same zero-write/zero-side-effect path.
- R7 concurrent revision drift returns FLOW_STATE_ATOMIC_STALE without retry/re-resolution, while unchanged revision promotes exactly once.
- R8 next-action CLI/API/artifact parity and pre-validation-promotion removal are verified against the mapped owners.
- R9 spec-local, shared get-next-action/writer tests, and full npm regression cover invalid, drift, exact success, and retry behavior.

Emit logger/artifact/runtime-log/retry effects only after commit and preserve existing exact-action envelope content.
